results.title: Madison County Parcels
results.description:
Overview

This feature service provides parcel boundaries for Madison County, Illinois, along with associated site address and property attribution. It supports parcel reference, address lookup, and cadastral mapping workflows for local government, planning, and public access uses.

Layer
  • County Parcels: A polygon layer representing individual parcels in Madison County. The layer includes parcel identification, mailing or site address components, community information, and basic land measurements such as square footage and acreage.
Geographic Coverage

The service covers Madison County, Illinois.

Use Cases
  • Parcel identification and ownership reference
  • Site address and location lookups
  • Property assessment and cadastral mapping
  • Planning, permitting, and land records support
  • Public parcel viewing and download access
